headline: A 2022 law names a planned VA outpatient clinic in Oahu, Hawaii, after the late Senator Daniel Kahikina Akaka.
what_it_does: This law gives a planned Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Oahu, Hawaii, an official name: the Daniel Kahikina Akaka Department of Veterans Affairs Community-Based Outpatient Clinic. It may also be called the Daniel Kahikina Akaka VA Clinic. The law only sets the name and does not change clinic services, eligibility, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The naming took effect when the law was enacted on June 7, 2022.
